disclaimer: 3D Navier-Stokes global regularity is OPEN. No node in this graph is a proof of it. Status values are descriptive bookkeeping, not claims of resolution.

status_vocabulary.CERTIFIED_STANDARD: published mathematics, cited, not our contribution
status_vocabulary.CERTIFIED_STANDARD_VERIFY_CITATION: as above but the exact hypotheses/constants were not verifiable from this runtime
status_vocabulary.NO_GO_PROVEN: proved here that this route cannot close
status_vocabulary.THEOREM_CONDITIONAL: proved here by reduction; hypothesis unproved
status_vocabulary.CONJECTURE: stated so it can be false; not assumed anywhere
status_vocabulary.DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: measurable, but no theorem connects it to regularity
status_vocabulary.PREREGISTERED: falsifiable hypothesis fixed before the campaign
status_vocabulary.BLOCKED: cannot proceed until a prerequisite changes status
status_vocabulary.SMOKE_TEST_ONLY: pipeline validation; carries no evidential weight
